copy.curiosityHook: What awaits the primate crew once they navigate deep space and touch down on an unknown world?
copy.description: After an unmanned space shuttle crashes on an uncharted planet, NASA launches a trio of astronaut chimpanzees straight through a wormhole to investigate the alien world in Kirk DeMicco's animated sci-fi comedy.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, cheerful, and low-demand, blending playful sci-fi peril with light comic warmth for family movie night.
copy.whyWatch: Clocking in at an energetic 81 minutes, this family-friendly adventure pairs colorful sci-fi exploration with lighthearted comedy for a breezy, quick-moving watch.
